profile.name: Shohail Aamil
profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Azure Cloud Enthusiast | .NET & Angular
profile.summary: Innovative and passionate software engineer with experience building full-stack enterprise applications, APIs, reusable components, integrations, and cloud-based solutions. Dedicated, adaptable, and comfortable collaborating in challenging Agile environments.
profile.availability: Open to professional networking and meaningful engineering opportunities

highlights: Develops and scales enterprise software using modern .NET and Angular technologies.
Contributes to secure, maintainable, and high-impact solutions for education payment and catering workflows.
Collaborates in an Agile environment using Azure DevOps and Git.
Designed and delivered full-stack features for project management and contracting applications.
Built reusable Angular components and scalable .NET APIs.
Worked with stakeholders and engineering teams in Agile delivery environments.
Developed backend APIs and Angular user interfaces for enterprise contracting products.
Contributed to scheduling, licensing, project planning, and reusable component solutions.
Participated in testing, quality assurance, task planning, and customer-focused delivery.
Developed enterprise integrations and business applications using .NET, Angular, and SQL Server.
Implemented payroll integrations, scheduled jobs, reports, and customer-requested enhancements.
Demonstrated completed solutions to teammates and customers.
Created technical content covering modern web development technologies and frameworks.
